enchantments.tooltip: Potency +49: Passive: +49 Equipment bonus to each Spell Power.
Hallowed: An item with this quality assists only wearers who have the ability to turn undead. Hallowed items provide an +6 Enhancement bonus to the maximum Hit Dice of undead turned.
Sacred +6: An item with this quality assists only wearers who have the ability to turn undead. Sacred items provide an +6 Enhancement bonus to your effective level for Turning Undead.
Turning : This will increase the total number of Turn Undead attempts you can use by 3. However, these additional Turn Undead attempts will only take effect after the wielder rests.
